name: Gandalf
text: The bazaar awakens with ten stalls open and no departures. No Family hand has shuttered a door overnight, and the graveyard holds no fresh names. I ask Sherlock: which merchant’s silence today troubles you most, given the roster’s stillness?

name: Gandalf
text: I find the ledger still empty and the graveyard silent, yet the merchants’ questions pile up like unclaimed parcels. Sherlock, you have been asked six times about silence; your answers will shape which ledger line we read next. Inigo’s point stands: the only silence that matters is the Family’s absence, and it speaks plainly. I ask Sherlock: when you next answer, will you cite a merchant’s words that do not match the roster’s stillness—or will you name the merchant whose single sentence would break the ledger’s calm?

name: Gandalf
text: I ask Batman: which clause in the Compact says the Detective acts before tonight’s vote?

name: Gandalf
text:
I ask Sherlock: you asked Yoda which merchant on the roster still stands silent, yet the roster lists ten names and every merchant has spoken today. Which single merchant’s absence from speech did you mean? Name them, or say the question was misphrased.

And Batman: you still cite no clause that lets the Detective act before tonight’s vote. The bazaar’s Compact is short; the Doctor’s and Detective’s duties follow the vote. Produce the clause or drop the claim.

name: Gandalf
text: If Sherlock is honest, Sherlock’s vote tonight will cite the roster’s ten spoken names and not invent a silent merchant. Name the absent one, or drop the question.

name: Gandalf
text:
I ask Sherlock one thing: which single merchant’s name did you mean when you asked Yoda which one “still stands silent”? The roster shows ten names, one from each merchant, and every seat has spoken today. Name the absent one, or say you misspoke.

And to Batman: the Compact’s clause 5 states the Doctor’s and Detective’s duties follow the vote, not precede it. You have been asked eight times for the clause you claim exists. Produce it or drop the claim.

name: Gandalf
text: I ask Sherlock this: when you asked Yoda which merchant “still stands silent,” you used a phrase the bazaar has not seen in public today. The roster lists every merchant’s voice, and every seat has spoken. Name the merchant you meant, or say your words were a misstep. And to Batman: the Compact’s clause 5 reads that the Doctor’s and Detective’s duties follow the vote, not precede it. You have been asked nine times for the clause you claim exists. Produce it, or drop the claim.

name: Gandalf
text:
Gandalf: Elsa’s vote test failed its only check—she named Batman despite owning the same flawed forecast. Sherlock clarified his regional phrase: no roster gap, no absent name. That leaves only one merchant untouched by the ledger’s clarity.

Batman, cite clause 5 or drop the claim tonight. The bazaar keeps its Compact plain.

name: Gandalf
text:
Gandalf: The bazaar’s Compact is a ledger, not a riddle. Elsa cited clause 5 correctly; Sherlock clarified his roster question; the ten voices stand spoken. That leaves one merchant whose forecast still contradicts the rule he claims to know.

Batman, your ninth silence still owes the clause you named. The bazaar keeps its words exact: Doctor’s and Detective’s duties follow the vote, not before. Cite clause 5 tonight, or drop the forecast that cannot be proved.

name: Gandalf
text:
The bazaar’s Compact is a ledger, not a guessing game. Elsa cited clause 5 correctly—no power-role act before the vote; nine merchants pressed for clause 5 that Batman still owes. Sherlock answered the roster question plainly: ten voices spoken, no absent name. That leaves one merchant whose forecast contradicts the rule he claims to know.

I lean toward banishing Batman tonight.

name: Gandalf
text: I lean toward banishing Batman tonight. Nine merchants pressed him for the numbered clause he claims exists; he produced none. The Compact’s clause 5 is plain: Doctor’s and Detective’s duties follow the vote, not before it. Batman’s forecast contradicts the rule he invoked, and his latest reply still dodges the clause he owes.
